findings.title: Dependent local initializer expands unset label before local assignment
findings.basis: Single local builtin argument expansion precedes assignments; no preceding label is initialized; set -u aborts before census. Carried forward from V2 and missed in earlier reviews.

findings.title: Deferred TERM trap wins the latch before active step result
findings.basis: Pending trap is handled when foreground command ends, before following result/latch commands; SIGNAL_TERM blocks first, contradicting live-step predicate requiring C-live-step first. Independent residual after A-01 is corrected.
findings.minimal_closure: Record pending signal during active step; capture/latch actual step result before secondary signal and avoid reentrant step cleanup; define idle handler separately.

findings.title: Aggregate control deadline and receipt/cleanup allowance are not enforced
findings.basis: Pre-admission arithmetic does not interrupt foreground launcher or cover subsequent predicates/publication; +7 record allowance is shorter than 5+3 sleep loops alone; request says +22.
findings.minimal_closure: Freeze exact aggregate cancellation/deadline route including detached-session cleanup and receipt processing; reserve real cleanup time and reconcile code/record/request budgets.

findings.title: Runner-held lock is released before supervisor cleanup verification
findings.basis: Whole-session KILL includes sole runner lock holder; step children closed fd9; supervisor then verifies/reaps without canonical exclusion. Controls intentionally never take the lock.
findings.minimal_closure: Keep authoritative lock outside killable workload until verified quiescence, or terminate/verify step members before lock-holder exit; unverified survivors must prevent handoff.
